name: The Defense of Grom'gol
label: Quest
description: Commander Aggro'gosh seeks to safeguard Grom'gol's supply lines through Stranglethorn Vale. After the earlier hunt thinning the raptors outside the camp…
intro: Commander Aggro'gosh seeks to safeguard Grom'gol's supply lines through Stranglethorn Vale. After the earlier hunt thinning the raptors outside the camp, a band of ogres encamped at the nearby Mizjah Ruins continues to harass supply caravans heading toward Stonard.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: When we first arrived in this jungle we did not intend to wage war on the local tribes. Our mission to supply Stonard is of the highest priority. But complications have arisen. A local band of ogres has occupied the Mizjah Ruins to the southeast of Grom'gol. Despite warnings, they continue to ambush our supply caravans.
I am putting you in charge of dealing with these uncooperative ogres.
Travel to the ruins and attempt to drive them from the area. At the very least it will send a firm message.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you made any progress with the ogres of the Mizjah Ruins yet, adventurer?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done. You have served the Warchief with honor.
